snippet.title: Step Into a New Era of Deco Online!
snippet.description:
Step Into a New Era of Deco Online!

We are thrilled to announce that we’ve started reworking the game’s graphics! Originally, we planned to release a new full client with the upgraded visuals. However, we’ve decided to roll out the graphic updates in smaller, incremental updates so you can see our progress step by step.

With today’s update, four maps' monsters have been updated with a new design and modern animations:

Tears of Destroyer
Kabala Dump
Forgotten Sea
Frozen Lake

Additionally, we will be upgrading the game client to Visual Studio 2025 to ensure better performance and stability.

Thank you and have fun with Deco Online. ^^
